hyperedges.label: IDOR / privilege-escalation fixes shipped in migration 0003
State-changing RPCs re-checking role inside the function body
Dual-validation write path (Formik+Yup client, Zod in Server Action)

nodes.label: Admin Layout Role Gate (admin/layout.tsx)
nodes.rationale: The admin panel is role-gated in proxy.ts and then again in admin/layout.tsx — defense in depth, so a proxy matcher gap cannot expose admin pages.

nodes.label: create_sales_order() RPC
nodes.rationale: Prices every order line from the products/product_variants tables inside the function, so client-supplied prices are structurally impossible.

nodes.label: lib/image-compress.ts WebP Re-encoding
nodes.rationale: Product images are re-encoded to WebP and capped at 1600px on the long edge before upload to keep R2 storage and bandwidth usage low.

nodes.label: proxy.ts (Next 16 middleware.ts replacement)
nodes.rationale: Next 16 renames middleware.ts to proxy.ts; it handles locale routing, session refresh, and role-gating for /admin, /account, /requests and /checkout.

nodes.label: sanitizeRedirectPath()
nodes.rationale: Accepts same-site relative paths only, so `?next=` can never point off-site.

nodes.label: set_user_role() RPC
nodes.rationale: Re-checks admin-only server-side and rejects self-role-change, so the Admin -> Staff UI cannot be bypassed by calling the RPC directly.

nodes.label: validateBoth() (lib/validate.ts)
nodes.rationale: Runs both the Yup and Zod schemas and throws if either rejects — the single enforcement point for the dual-validation rule.

nodes.label: First Admin Bootstrap Procedure
nodes.rationale: Registration always creates a `customer` profile — there is deliberately no signup path granting admin/staff, since self-promotion is the exact privilege-escalation bug §5 closes. The first admin therefore requires temporarily disabling the anti-escalation trigger in raw SQL; every later promotion goes through the Admin -> Staff UI.

nodes.label: Odoo-Style Admin Panel
nodes.rationale: Covers products, categories, sales orders, FIFO inventory, purchases, accounting and requests — modeled on Odoo's ERP module split so back-office flows mirror a familiar ERP rather than an ad-hoc CRUD dashboard.

nodes.label: Admin Storage Review Page (/admin/storage)
nodes.rationale: Admin-only page that flags unreferenced product images and payment screenshots/request attachments from orders closed more than 90 days ago. Deletion is always manual and reviewed, never automatic, so no cleanup job can destroy live evidence.

nodes.label: Bilingual Locale Routing (ar RTL default, en LTR)
nodes.rationale: Arabic is the default locale served at `/` unprefixed (RTL); English lives at `/en` (LTR). Locale-prefixed routing keeps the Arabic-first audience on the canonical root path.
nodes.norm_label: bilingual locale routing (ar rtl default, en ltr)

nodes.label: Cloudflare R2 File Storage
nodes.rationale: All uploads (product images, payment screenshots, request attachments) go to R2 rather than the server filesystem because Vercel serverless functions have no persistent local disk. R2 is chosen over other object stores for its S3 compatibility and zero egress fees.

nodes.label: lib/data Read-Only Supabase Queries
nodes.rationale: Read-only queries consumed by Server Components, deliberately separated from the mutating Server Actions.

nodes.label: Dual Validation (Yup client + Zod server)
nodes.rationale: Every DB-writing Server Action validates through two independent libraries: Formik+Yup client-side for UX, then Zod again inside the Server Action. A bug or omission in one library's schema cannot on its own let malformed data through, since both must agree. The client-side check is never trusted as the only gate.

nodes.label: force-dynamic Request-Time Rendering
nodes.rationale: Every Supabase-backed route is marked `force-dynamic` so no build-time network calls to Supabase happen — the build never fails because the database is unreachable.

nodes.label: Nodemailer Gmail SMTP Notifications
nodes.rationale: Request/Contact notifications send via Gmail SMTP using an App Password (requires 2FA), not the account password; the destination defaults to GMAIL_SMTP_USER when REQUESTS_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL is unset.

nodes.label: RLS Row-Level Security (row-level, not column-level)
nodes.rationale: The recurring root cause behind two of the fixes: Postgres RLS gates which rows a caller may touch, not which columns or values. It can check row ownership but never column-level authorization or price correctness, so anything beyond ownership needs a trigger or a SECURITY DEFINER RPC.

nodes.label: SECURITY DEFINER RPC Pattern
nodes.rationale: Because SECURITY DEFINER runs the function with elevated privileges regardless of the caller's RLS grants, the role/auth.uid() re-check inside the function body is the actual security boundary — not a UI convenience. Every state-changing RPC performs that check itself.

nodes.label: lib/actions Server Actions
nodes.rationale: Mutations only, one file per domain — keeping writes out of the read-only lib/data layer.

nodes.label: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY (server-only secret)
nodes.rationale: Service role key bypasses RLS entirely, so it is confined to server code and must never be exposed to the client.

nodes.label: Supabase Postgres/Auth/Realtime Backend
nodes.rationale: Schema and seed data live in the `iconictech-it` Supabase org; migrations must be run in order against any different project before seeding.

nodes.label: lib/supabase Client Triad (browser / server / admin)
nodes.rationale: Three distinct clients — client.ts (browser), server.ts (RSC/actions), admin.ts (service role) — so the service-role key can only ever be reached from the admin client on the server.

nodes.label: supabase/migrations Schema History
nodes.rationale: Full ordered schema history; pointing at a different Supabase project means replaying the migrations in order before running supabase/seed.sql.

nodes.label: Vercel Deployment
nodes.rationale: Deliberately domain-agnostic: the free *.vercel.app URL works out of the box and attaching a custom domain later needs no code change beyond NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.

nodes.label: node_modules/next/dist/docs Guides
nodes.rationale: Guides are resolved relative to AGENTS.md's own directory because in monorepos the `next` package may not be visible from the repo root.

nodes.label: 7oor Project Instructions (CLAUDE.md)
nodes.rationale: CLAUDE.md is a single `@AGENTS.md` import so the Next.js agent rules stay in one canonical file instead of being duplicated and drifting.

nodes.label: 7oor Store
nodes.rationale: Bilingual (Arabic default/RTL, English/LTR) e-commerce site for mobile accessories, chargers, stationery and printing services, with an Odoo-style admin panel. Built on Next.js 16 App Router + Turbopack, TypeScript, Tailwind v4, Supabase, Cloudflare R2, GSAP/Framer Motion, Formik+Yup+Zod, Nodemailer, @react-pdf/renderer.

nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules Block
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes versus model training data, so agents must read the bundled guides before writing code rather than relying on memorized APIs. The block is machine-regenerated by `next dev`, so deleting it only recreates an uncommitted diff — committing it alongside the work keeps the tree clean.

nodes.label: Invoice Forgery Fix
nodes.rationale: A direct client insert into `invoices` could set status = 'paid' on a self-created invoice. Fixed by dropping that policy entirely — invoices are now only ever created by confirm_sales_order()/mark_sales_order_done().

nodes.label: No Automated Test Suite
nodes.rationale: Verification relied on TypeScript type-checking, ESLint, clean production builds after every phase, and direct database queries/RPC calls through the Supabase tool instead of a test suite.

nodes.label: No Live Browser QA in Build Environment
nodes.rationale: The sandbox's egress policy returned an explicit 403 on every outbound connection to the Supabase host from application code — a policy denial, not a code bug. Schema/data work was unaffected because the Supabase MCP tool reaches Supabase through the harness's own infrastructure, outside the sandbox proxy, so migrations, RPCs and seed data were applied and verified for real.
nodes.norm_label: no live browser qa in build environment

nodes.label: NULL Role Bypass Bug (coalesce fix)
nodes.rationale: An earlier version of the in-function role checks let an unauthenticated caller through: app_role() returned NULL and PL/pgSQL evaluates `IF NULL THEN` as false, silently skipping the guard. Fixed by wrapping the call in coalesce(app_role(), '').

nodes.label: Open Redirect Fix
nodes.rationale: Login's `?next=` param was passed straight to redirect() unchecked, so a crafted login link could send an authenticated user to an external URL. Fixed by allowing same-site relative paths only.

nodes.label: PDF Invoices Render English/Latin Only
nodes.rationale: @react-pdf/renderer's built-in fonts (Helvetica etc.) carry no Arabic glyphs, and the build sandbox had no network access to fetch an Arabic-capable font. Remedy is bundling a .ttf (Cairo, Tajawal) under public/fonts/ and registering it with Font.register(); the invoice logic itself does not change.

nodes.label: Price Tampering Prevention
nodes.rationale: A direct client INSERT into `sales_order_items` could set any `unit_price`, and RLS can only check row ownership, not price correctness. Fixed by dropping the direct-insert policies and routing all order creation through create_sales_order(), which prices every line server-side; the client only ever sends product/variant ids and quantities.

nodes.label: Role Self-Escalation Fix
nodes.rationale: A policy like `auth.uid() = id` lets a customer PATCH their own profile row — including the `role` column — up to admin, because RLS is row-level not column-level. Fixed with a BEFORE UPDATE trigger rejecting any non-admin attempt to change `role`.
